_anchors.light.x: -0.35: the sun is higher and more frontal than the street's — a bluebird morning, and Yoshi's Island light is even, not raking.
_anchors.light.y: -0.75, high. His reference is lit from almost overhead; long shadows are not in its vocabulary.
_anchors.light.z: -0.35, toward the viewer: YI shading is frontal and soft.
_anchors.light.curve: 0.95, just under linear — the reference's shading is soft steps, never a hard rim. The crypt's 1.3 is the opposite end of this knob.
_anchors.tones.perMaterial: 5, the 15/08 idiom — binding regardless of reference. YI itself works in about this many tones per surface.
_anchors.outline.enabled: true — his reference outlines EVERYTHING, which is half of what 'Yoshi Island' means at this scale.
_anchors.outline.material: "ink", but WARM: crayon brown-black, not the street's blue-black. Extracted from the reference at intake.
_anchors.outline.inner: true; welds decide, the kitten rule.
_anchors.texture.dither: 0, the body rule from the skate round: a small body has no surface for a lattice. The checker lives on the sky and the snowfield.
_anchors.texture.lattice: 2, unused at 0 on bodies; declared 2 because if it is ever turned on, 2 is the YI checker.
_anchors.shadow.strength: 1 ramp step — HALF the street's 2, extracted from the reference: YI self-shadow is a tint, not a plunge.
_anchors.fill.y: 0.55, from below and STRONG in direction: snow is the brightest bounce card there is.
_anchors.fill.weight: 0.14, above the street's 0.1 — snow bounce, and the reference's shadows stay coloured because of it.
_anchors.body.scale: 1: the subject draws at the world's own scale; the register is the scene's.
_anchors.canvas.w: 44: the banked body sweeps a 17 px radius about the core; ±22 holds the worst frame of the carve plus the line.
_anchors.canvas.h: 44, square with the width: a 36° bank turns height into width and back, so the cell is the swept circle, not the rest pose.
_anchors.canvas.originX: 22, the core — the centre of the bank.
_anchors.canvas.originY: 22, the core. The board reaches 15 below, the pom 17 above; banked, both sweep inside the 22.
_anchors.frames.walk: 8, the glide's four phases at the quarters.
_anchors.gait.swing: 0.04 turn: the glide's largest key is 0.12 on an arm — under 2°. The null case is supposed to be boring.
_anchors.gait.lift: 2 px: a straight run barely bobs.
_anchors.gait.roll: 0 — THE NULL CASE of the composition experiment: no roll anywhere in the glide, upright root, and the drift instrument measures zero here before it is believed at the carve.
_anchors.playback.msPerFrame: 90, bench only: the glide advances with distance in the game.
